title: GLM 5.2 vs. Opus
summary: A technical comparison between Zhipu AI's GLM 5.2 and Anthropic's Claude Opus language models, examining their capabilities, performance benchmarks, and practical applications across different use cases.
problem_solved: Provides an objective comparison to help developers and businesses choose between two leading AI models for their specific needs.
why_valuable: Enables informed decision-making by comparing two major LLM systems across dimensions like reasoning, coding, multilingual support, and cost efficiency.
